messages.content: Write one complete TypeScript Playwright test using import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'. Open http://localhost:8181/settings, click the button named Add MCP server, fill inputs labeled Name and URL with Local tools and http://127.0.0.1:9000/mcp, click Save, assert Local tools is visible, reload, and assert it is still visible. Use accessible locators. Output one fenced TypeScript block.
